description: openclaude - OpenClaude, an open-source AI coding agent for your terminal (a fork of Claude Code).

option.name: --add-dir
tip: U: --add-dir <directories...>
Additional directories to allow tool access to.

option.name: --agent
tip: U: --agent <agent>
Agent for the current session. Overrides the 'agent' setting.

option.name: --agents
tip: U: --agents <json>
JSON object defining custom agents.

option.name: --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions
tip: Enable bypassing all permission checks as an option.

option.name: --allowed-tools
tip: U: --allowedTools <tools...>
Comma or space-separated list of tool names to allow.

option.name: --append-system-prompt
tip: U: --append-system-prompt <prompt>
Append a system prompt to the default system prompt.

option.name: --bare
tip: Minimal mode: skip hooks, LSP, plugin sync, attribution, auto-memory, background prefetches, keychain reads, and CLAUDE.md auto-discovery.

option.name: --betas
tip: U: --betas <betas...>
Beta headers to include in API requests (API key users only).

option.name: --chrome
tip: Enable Claude in Chrome integration.

option.name: --continue
tip: Continue the most recent conversation in the current directory.

option.name: --dangerously-skip-permissions
tip: Bypass all permission checks. Recommended only for sandboxes with no internet access.

option.name: --debug
tip: U: -d, --debug [filter]
Enable debug mode with optional category filtering.

option.name: --debug-file
tip: U: --debug-file <path>
Write debug logs to a specific file path (implicitly enables debug mode).

option.name: --disable-slash-commands
tip: Disable all skills.

option.name: --disallowed-tools
tip: U: --disallowedTools <tools...>
Comma or space-separated list of tool names to deny.

option.name: --effort
tip: U: --effort <level>
Effort level for the current session.

option.name: --fallback-model
tip: U: --fallback-model <model>
Enable automatic fallback to specified model when default model is overloaded.

option.name: --file
tip: U: --file <specs...>
File resources to download at startup. Format: file_id:relative_path.

option.name: --fork-session
tip: When resuming, branch the conversation into a new session ID.

option.name: --from-pr
tip: U: --from-pr [value]
Resume a session linked to a PR by PR number/URL, or open interactive picker.

option.name: --heartbeat
tip: U: --heartbeat <duration>
Emit a headless liveness heartbeat while output is quiet (only works with --print).

option.name: --ide
tip: Automatically connect to IDE on startup if exactly one valid IDE is available.

option.name: --include-hook-events
tip: Include all hook lifecycle events in the output stream (only works with --output-format=stream-json).

option.name: --include-partial-messages
tip: Include partial message chunks as they arrive (only works with --print and --output-format=stream-json).

option.name: --input-format
tip: U: --input-format <format>
Input format (only works with --print): "text" (default), or "stream-json".

option.name: --json-schema
tip: U: --json-schema <schema>
JSON Schema for structured output validation.

option.name: --max-budget-usd
tip: U: --max-budget-usd <amount>
Maximum dollar amount to spend on API calls (only works with --print).

option.name: --max-turns
tip: U: --max-turns <turns>
Maximum number of agentic turns per prompt.

option.name: --mcp-config
tip: U: --mcp-config <configs...>
Load MCP servers from JSON files or strings (space-separated).

option.name: --mcp-debug
tip: Enable MCP debug mode (shows MCP server errors). Deprecated: Use --debug instead.

option.name: --model
tip: U: --model <model>
Model for the current session. Provide an alias (e.g. 'sonnet' or 'opus') or a full model name.

option.name: --name
tip: U: -n, --name <name>
Set a display name for this session.

option.name: --no-chrome
tip: Disable Claude in Chrome integration.

option.name: --no-session-persistence
tip: Disable session persistence - sessions will not be saved to disk and cannot be resumed.

option.name: --output-format
tip: U: --output-format <format>
Output format (only works with --print): "text", "json", or "stream-json".

option.name: --permission-mode
tip: U: --permission-mode <mode>
Permission mode to use for the session.

option.name: --plugin-dir
tip: U: --plugin-dir <path>
Load plugins from a directory for this session only (repeatable).

option.name: --print
tip: Print response and exit (useful for pipes).

option.name: --prompt-suggestions
tip: U: --prompt-suggestions [value]
Enable prompt suggestions. In print/SDK mode, emits a prompt_suggestion message after each turn.

option.name: --provider
tip: U: --provider <provider>
AI provider to use (anthropic, openai, gemini, github, bedrock, vertex, ollama).

option.name: --provider-env-file
tip: U: --provider-env-file <path>
Load provider environment variables from a file before validation (repeatable).

option.name: --replay-user-messages
tip: Re-emit user messages from stdin back on stdout for acknowledgment (only works with --input-format=stream-json and --output-format=stream-json).

option.name: --resume
tip: U: -r, --resume [value]
Resume a conversation by session ID, or open interactive picker.

option.name: --session-id
tip: U: --session-id <uuid>
Use a specific session ID for the conversation.

option.name: --setting-sources
tip: U: --setting-sources <sources>
Comma-separated list of setting sources to load (user, project, local).

option.name: --settings
tip: U: --settings <file-or-json>
Path to a settings JSON file or a JSON string to load additional settings from.

option.name: --strict-mcp-config
tip: Only use MCP servers from --mcp-config, ignoring all other MCP configurations.

option.name: --system-prompt
tip: U: --system-prompt <prompt>
System prompt to use for the session.

option.name: --system-prompt-snapshot
tip: U: --system-prompt-snapshot <on|off>
Record the system prompt once per conversation and reuse it verbatim.

option.name: --tmux
tip: Create a tmux session for the worktree (requires --worktree).

option.name: --tools
tip: U: --tools <tools...>
Specify the list of available tools from the built-in set.

option.name: --version
tip: Output the version number.

option.name: --worktree
tip: U: -w, --worktree [name]
Create a new git worktree for this session (optionally specify a name).

root.name: agents
tip: List configured agents.

root.name: aimlapi
tip: AI/ML API (aimlapi.com) — top up balance and configure the provider.

root.name: auth
tip: Manage authentication.

root.name: auto-mode
tip: Inspect auto mode classifier configuration.

root.name: doctor
tip: Check the health of your OpenClaude auto-updater.

root.name: install
tip: Install OpenClaude native build.

root.name: mcp
tip: Configure and manage MCP servers.

root.name: plugin
tip: Manage OpenClaude plugins.

root.name: report
tip: Generate a deterministic task report for an OpenClaude session.

root.name: setup-token
tip: Set up a long-lived authentication token (requires Claude subscription).

root.name: skills
tip: List, inspect, validate, and manage OpenClaude skills.

root.name: update
tip: Check for updates and install if available.

common_option.name: -h
tip: Display help for command.
